Content-primary-c1.$description: Text 1, icon 1, Content 1. Primary text and icon color.

Content-secondary-c2.$description: Text 2, icon 2, Content 2. Secondary text and icon color.

Content-tertiary-c3.$description: Text 3, icon 3, Content 3. Tertiary text and icon color.

Content-quaternary-c4.$description: Text 4, icon 4, Content 4. Quaternary text and icon color.

Content-primary-inverse-c1i.$description: Text 1i, icon 1i. Primary text and icon color that inverts against the current theme. Appears white on light mode, dark on dark mode.

Content-secondary-inverse-c2i.$description: Text 2i, icon 2i. Secondary text and icon color that inverts against the current theme. Appears white on light mode, dark on dark mode.

Content-tertiary-inverse-c3i.$description: Text 3i, icon 3i. Tertiary text and icon color that inverts against the current theme. Appears white on light mode, dark on dark mode.

Content-quaternary-inverse-c4i.$description: Text 4i, icon 4i. Quaternary text and icon color that inverts against the current theme. Appears white on light mode, dark on dark mode.

Content-always-white.$description: Text white, icon white. Text and icon color that is always white regardless of theme. Use when color must never flip between light and dark mode.

Content-always-black.$description: Text black, icon black. Text and icon color that is always black regardless of theme. Use when color must never flip between light and dark mode.

Content-Interactive.$description: Text interactive, icon interactive. Text and icon color for interactive elements such as links, active tabs, and selected states.

Content-Destructive.$description: Text destructive, icon destructive. Text and icon color for destructive actions such as delete, remove, and error states.

Content-Success.$description: Text success, icon success. Text and icon color for success states such as confirmations, completed actions, and positive feedback.

Content-Warning.$description: Text warning, icon warning. Text and icon color for warning states such as caution messages, alerts, and pending actions.

Section-0-Basement-s0.$description: Section 0, s0. Base page and screen background. The lowest surface level.

Section-1-first-floor-s1.$description: Section 1, s1. Card, panel, and container background. One level above the base.

Section-2-second-floor-s2.$description: Section 2, s2. Elevated surface background. Use for popovers, dropdowns, and floating elements.

Section-0-Basement-inverse-s0i.$description: Section 0i, s0i. Base background that inverts against the current theme. Appears dark on light mode, light on dark mode.

Section-1-first-floor-inverse-s1i.$description: Section 1i, s1i. Card and panel background that inverts against the current theme. Appears dark on light mode, light on dark mode.

Section-2-second-floor-inverse-s2i.$description: Section 2i, s2i. Elevated surface background that inverts against the current theme. Appears dark on light mode, light on dark mode.

Section-Interactive.$description: Section interactive. Background color for interactive states such as hover, focus, and selected surfaces.

Section-Destructive.$description: Section destructive. Background color for destructive actions such as delete confirmations, error banners, and warning surfaces.

Section-Success.$description: Section success. Background color for success states such as confirmation banners and completed action surfaces.

Section-Warning.$description: Section warning. Background color for warning states such as caution banners and alert surfaces.

Section-Neon-Green.$description: Section neon green. Palmstreet primary CTA background. Use for primary buttons and key action surfaces.

Scrim-1-heavy.$description: Scrim heavy. Heavy overlay background for modals and full-screen overlays.

Scrim-2-light.$description: Scrim light. Light overlay background for drawers and partial overlays.

Section-primary-always-white.$description: Section always white. Background that is always white regardless of theme. Use when surface must never flip between light and dark mode.

Section-primary-always-black.$description: Section always black. Background that is always black regardless of theme. Use when surface must never flip between light and dark mode.

Line.$description: Default border and divider color. Use for separating content areas and components.

Line2.$description: Strong border and divider color. Use for emphasized separators and focused states.

Line-Destructive.$description: Destructive border color. Use for error state inputs, destructive action borders.

Line-Success.$description: Success border color. Use for success state inputs and confirmed action borders.
